sm.$description: Micro-interactions like focus rings and state changes

md.$description: Standard transitions like menus and popovers

lg.$description: Deliberate animations like slides and reveals

xl.$description: Extended animations like complex or multi-step transitions

standard.$description: Balanced easing for state changes like hover, color, and toggle transitions

decelerate.$description: Decelerating easing for elements entering the screen, such as menus and popovers

accelerate.$description: Accelerating easing for elements leaving the screen

emphasized-decelerate.$description: Expressive entrance for prominent elements like dialogs and drawers

emphasized-accelerate.$description: Expressive exit for prominent elements like dialogs and drawers
